Generated metric definitions for netlink counters and gauges.

# Purpose
This header defines the metric metadata for the `netlnk` area of the system. It lists counter and gauge entries with fixed offsets, metric names, types, descriptions, and converter settings, so other parts of the code can register and read these values in a stable layout. The file also defines grouped metric sets such as `FD_METRICS_COUNTER_NETLNK_UPDATES` and `FD_METRICS_GAUGE_NETLNK_ROUTE_COUNT`, which map related submetrics to consecutive offsets. The `FD_METRICS_NETLNK_TOTAL` value and the `FD_METRICS_NETLNK` array declaration provide the total number of metric records and the exported metadata table used by the metrics framework.
